source_text.body:
Clean up a Facebook timeline (ended in suspension)
A user had Muse clean up their Facebook timeline and believes this contributed to an account suspension.
·
Oct 31, 2026
Done with
MM
Meta Muse
What they did
The user connected Muse to Facebook and had it clean up their timeline, then later said Facebook had also been placed into Meta Horizon and they moved it back out into AI Account Center. In the same stretch, Muse surfaced an unknown login from two hours away, and the user and commenters inferred that was likely Muse’s remote virtual machine rather than the user’s own device.
How it went
The account was suspended for suspicious activity, and the user believes the timeline cleanup was one trigger. The thread offers no recovery metrics; replies only mention mixed fixes like revoking Facebook access, logging out sessions, and changing the password.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that automating bulk Facebook timeline changes through Muse may look like account takeover activity and lead to a lockout.
Try it yourself
with
Meta Muse
Copy prompt
Review my Facebook timeline and list old posts that match [criteria, e.g. before 2018, contain tagged photos of others] as candidates for removal. Do not delete or change anything. Show me the list and wait for my approval, and work in small batches at a normal human pace so I don't trigger account limits.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/MuseAgent/comments/1xjkw74/got_suspended_be_careful_what_you_do_with_muse
